Subject: FinPay stakeholder map & MAP — post-call recap + next steps

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum going: 

Summary of needs (as I heard them):
- Primary use case: customer support summarization and routing; expected 50–70k messages/month initially.
- Latency target: under 200ms 95th on short prompts (support snippets).
- Data controls: VPC/private deploy for PII-sensitive logs; SOC 2 evidence required.

Stakeholder map (from today):
- Economic buyer: Sophie Chan (Head of Ops) — owns TCO and timeline.
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com — standard PO/SOW process.
- Security/legal: likely shared team; need SOC 2 + data residency confirmation.
- Engineering champion: Oliver Thompson (you) — integration owner.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I will send a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and owners by EOD tomorrow (attached as FinPay-MAP-v1.xlsx).
2) Neha (security lead) will start the security questionnaire and share SOC 2 artifacts; I attached the initial questionnaire we discussed.
3) Schedule a 30-min procurement sync with your procurement contact to align on PO timeline — can you share a preferred time window next week?

Deliverables & owners:
- Draft MAP (Camila) — target: 11 Feb
- Security questionnaire + evidence (Neha) — target: 13 Feb
- Procure sync (Oliver/Sophie) — target: week of Feb 16

If that looks right, I’ll send the MAP + DocuSign link for signatures and we can lock milestones.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Camila Reyes
